mentions.name: Vistarium
mentions.description: This web app uses a local AI model (Qwen 3.8 27B) to evaluate and tag public domain images from US national parks to find the best landscapes. Images are sorted by predicted aesthetic rating and can be filtered by time of day, color, orientation, and park.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Using a local model (qwen 3.8 27b) to evaluate and tag public domain images from US national parks to find the best landscapes.

They are sorted by predicted aesthetic rating and can be filtered by time of day, color, orientation, and park.
mentions.author: pivot_root
